summary: This class models the HPX Shortcuts screen and related workflows in an Android mobile application. It provides comprehensive test automation methods for managing shortcuts including creating, editing, deleting, and running shortcuts. The class supports multiple destination types (Print, Email, Save) with configurable settings like copies, color options, two-sided printing, email recipients, and file types. It implements the Page Object Model pattern with explicit waits, dynamic locator construction using f-strings, and consistent error handling through raise_e parameters. The class extends SmartFlow base class and uses self.driver for all UI interactions. Key automation patterns include: verification methods for screen titles and UI elements, click methods for buttons and toggles, input methods for text fields, selection methods for dropdowns with dynamic locators, and state checking methods that return boolean values. The class also handles confirmation dialogs, account management, Google Drive integration, and shortcut execution status monitoring.
